name: geo-viewer
description: Preview and inspect GeoJSON data directly in your browser, supports Chrome Extension and Web App

scripts.pack:zip: npm run build:ext && node scripts/pack-extension.cjs zip
scripts.pack:crx: npm run build:ext && node scripts/pack-extension.cjs crx
scripts.pack:both: npm run build:ext && node scripts/pack-extension.cjs both
scripts.pack:zip:drill: set VITE_ENABLE_DRILL_DOWN=true&& npm run build:ext && node scripts/pack-extension.cjs zip
scripts.pack:crx:drill: set VITE_ENABLE_DRILL_DOWN=true&& npm run build:ext && node scripts/pack-extension.cjs crx
scripts.pack:both:drill: set VITE_ENABLE_DRILL_DOWN=true&& npm run build:ext && node scripts/pack-extension.cjs both
